deleteConfirm.description: This permanently removes {{kind}} {{vmid}} ({{name}}) on node {{node}} including ALL its disks. There is no undo.

shutdown.title: Shutdown VM {{vmid}}
shutdown.description: Sends a graceful shutdown signal to {{name}} ({{kind}} {{vmid}}) on node {{node}}. The guest OS gets a chance to flush and exit cleanly. If it ignores the signal the VM stays running.

reboot.title: Reboot VM {{vmid}}
reboot.description: Reboots {{name}} ({{kind}} {{vmid}}) on node {{node}}. The guest OS does its normal restart cycle.

suspend.title: Suspend VM {{vmid}}
suspend.description: Pauses {{name}} ({{kind}} {{vmid}}) on node {{node}}. Network connections drop; the guest is frozen in memory until resumed.

forceStop.title: Force-stop VM {{vmid}}
forceStop.description: Immediately KILLS the qemu/lxc process for {{name}} ({{kind}} {{vmid}}) on node {{node}}. Equivalent to yanking the power cord, unflushed disk writes are lost; databases inside the guest may corrupt. Prefer Shutdown unless the guest is hung.

DeleteGuestDialog.title: Review guest deletion
DeleteGuestDialog.warning: Permanently delete these guests and their owned disks. There is no undo. Stop guests first; protection and provider locks are respected.
DeleteGuestDialog.limit: Proxmox cannot atomically match a reviewed configuration during deletion. Avoid concurrent changes outside FreeSDN. Backup jobs and unreferenced disks are not purged.
DeleteGuestDialog.loading: Reading the guest configurations for this review…
DeleteGuestDialog.reviewFailed: Review unavailable, protected, locked, or controller changed. Close this dialog and review again.
DeleteGuestDialog.readOnly: Device writes are disabled in read-only mode.
DeleteGuestDialog.accepted: Requests recorded. Check Pending Changes for provider completion; accepted does not mean deleted.
DeleteGuestDialog.type: Type DELETE to confirm these reviewed targets

CreateGuestDialog.title: Review guest creation
CreateGuestDialog.warning: Choose an explicit VMID. A suggested ID is not reserved; an allocation conflict stops this request.
CreateGuestDialog.frozen: This review is fixed. After a lost response, resubmit this same intent; do not open a new creation request until Pending Changes has been checked.
CreateGuestDialog.receipt: Creation receipt recorded. Accepted does not mean the guest or its applications are ready. Follow this operation in Pending Changes.
CreateGuestDialog.invalid: Enter a valid VMID, node, name, disk size and (for containers) template before review.
CreateGuestDialog.suggestFailed: Could not suggest an ID. Enter and review an explicit ID.
CreateGuestDialog.changed: Controller changed. Close and review on the intended controller.
CreateGuestDialog.passwordHint: The password is encrypted in the operation record and is never shown in its receipt.

ClusterOperationDialog.title: Review cluster operation
ClusterOperationDialog.warning: Node power can interrupt every guest and cluster access. HA changes can start, stop or move workloads. Verify maintenance, backups and recovery access before proceeding.
ClusterOperationDialog.limits: This review does not prove remaining quorum, storage availability, fencing safety or complete guest visibility under every ACL. External changes can race the final check.
ClusterOperationDialog.manual: Node power has no provider task ID. Completion remains unknown until you verify the host through an independent management path and resolve the receipt in Pending Changes.
ClusterOperationDialog.ha: HA readback verifies configuration only, not workload health or successful failover. Group operations require the legacy group API. Resource removal never purges HA rules.
ClusterOperationDialog.failed: Impact review unavailable. No command was sent. Close this dialog and review again.
ClusterOperationDialog.confirm: Type the exact target to confirm: {{target}}
ClusterOperationDialog.changed: The selected controller or action changed. Close and review again.
ClusterOperationDialog.receipt: Request recorded. Acceptance is not completion; inspect this receipt in Pending Changes.
ClusterOperationDialog.retry: The response was lost or rejected. Inspect Pending Changes. A manual retry here reuses the same request ID and reviewed parameters.

CertificateOperationDialog.title: Review certificate operation
CertificateOperationDialog.warning: Changing TLS can interrupt management access. Keep independent console access and a securely stored recovery certificate/key before proceeding.
CertificateOperationDialog.limits: Validation checks the key pair, supplied chain and certificate validity. It does not prove browser trust, hostname coverage, revocation status or every cluster endpoint. No automatic rollback or TLS trust downgrade is performed.
CertificateOperationDialog.acmeWarning: ACME renewal reloads the proxy and may revoke the old certificate. Account and DNS plugin credentials are not reconfigured here.
CertificateOperationDialog.restartWarning: Restarting the proxy may interrupt API and console connections. Without restart, stored changes may remain inactive.
CertificateOperationDialog.acmeForce: Renew even before the normal expiry window
CertificateOperationDialog.reviewFailed: Review failed. No write was sent. Retry this review or close and correct the certificate, key or options.
CertificateOperationDialog.confirm: Type the exact node to confirm: {{node}}
CertificateOperationDialog.changed: The selected target changed. Close and review again.
CertificateOperationDialog.retry: The response was not received. Inspect Pending Changes first. Retrying here uses the same request ID and frozen intent; do not start a new operation blindly.
CertificateOperationDialog.receipt: Request recorded. Acceptance does not prove activation. Follow the operation in Pending Changes; unresolved results require independent verification.

StorageOperationDialog.warning: Deletion is irreversible. Uploads must use a new filename. A recorded request is not proof of completion.
StorageOperationDialog.limits: Guest disks are excluded. ISO references are checked with the controller credentials; external changes and permission overrides can still race the review. Completion needs a matching task and storage readback, not secure erasure or an independent hash of stored bytes.
StorageOperationDialog.filePolicy: Maximum 4 GiB. Use an ASCII filename: .iso, .tar.gz, .tar.xz or .tar.zst. No paths, spaces or consecutive dots.
StorageOperationDialog.reviewFailed: Storage review unavailable or unsafe. Check storage health, permissions and references before trying again.
StorageOperationDialog.changed: The target changed. Close this dialog and review again.
StorageOperationDialog.failed: No verified receipt was received. Inspect Pending Changes before starting another request. Retrying here keeps the same request ID and file.

ReviewedBackupJob.warning: Saving a schedule does not prove that a backup ran or can be restored. Deleting a schedule does not delete archives or stop an existing run.
ReviewedBackupJob.limits: Select 1 to 64 explicit guest IDs on one node. Use HH:MM or weekdays followed by HH:MM in the node’s local time. New jobs keep all backups; monitor storage capacity. Existing retention and notifications are preserved. Stop/suspend mode can interrupt guests. An enabled job may run before readback completes.
ReviewedBackupJob.snapshot: Reviewed configuration, retention and guest selection
ReviewedBackupJob.error: The review or request could not be verified. Check Pending Changes before retrying or starting a new request. Advanced native options may require native management.

TaskStop.title: Review task termination
TaskStop.warning: Stopping a worker does not undo its changes. Backups, migrations and other operations may remain incomplete. A stop acknowledgement does not prove the task has stopped.
TaskStop.requirements: Requires node Sys.Audit and Sys.Modify privileges. Inspect the original operation and its effects before recovery.
TaskStop.confirm: Type the node name to confirm: {{node}}
TaskStop.error: Task review or submission is unavailable. Inspect Pending Changes before retrying. A retry here reuses the same request ID.
TaskStop.logUnavailable: Task log is unavailable. This does not mean the log is empty.

FirewallOps.title: Review firewall operation
FirewallOps.warning: Firewall changes can disconnect management and workloads. Saved configuration does not prove effective filtering or connectivity; no automatic rollback is provided.
FirewallOps.recovery: I have verified independent console or out-of-band recovery access.
FirewallOps.error: Review or request could not be verified. Inspect Pending Changes before trying again; do not repeat an uncertain write with a new request.

SdnInspection.title: SDN configuration inspection
SdnInspection.writeBoundary: SDN changes and apply are unavailable in FreeSDN until the reviewed native-lock workflow is qualified.
SdnInspection.visibility: These are permission-filtered observations, not an atomic or complete snapshot. Running configuration does not prove node reloads or connectivity.
SdnInspection.recovery: Use native Proxmox management for changes, with independent recovery access. Do not apply a management-network change based only on this inspection.

pending.no_visible_changes: No changes in the visible configuration

SdnInspection.permissions: Permission lookup: {{status}} · SDN.Audit: {{audit}} · SDN.Allocate: {{allocate}}. Permissions at /sdn do not prove visibility of every child object.
SdnInspection.unobserved: Not inspected: {{resources}}. Guest/interface impact and lock capabilities remain unverified.
SdnInspection.failed: SDN observation failed. Previous data must not be treated as current.
SdnInspection.empty: No visible objects. Permissions may hide other objects.
SdnInspection.diffBoundary: Read-only preview of generated interface and FRR changes. Raw content is withheld because it may contain credentials. This does not verify reachability or authorize apply.

SdnDependencies.title: SDN dependency coverage
SdnDependencies.boundary: Read-only, permission-filtered observations. This is not a complete dependency graph or approval to apply networking changes. Inspection uses at most three concurrent reads and a 20-second read budget. Secrets and unsupported policy fields are withheld.
SdnDependencies.reads: {{used}} of {{limit}} collection reads started (transport retries not counted)
SdnDependencies.parents: Selected {{selected}} visible VNet parents (limit {{limit}}); {{omitted}} additional visible parents were omitted by the limit. Hidden or unavailable parents may also exist.
SdnDependencies.limited: The response budget was reached. Some collections were not observed; they must not be treated as empty.
SdnDependencies.noCollection: No collection was observed for this selection. This does not prove that no objects exist.
SdnDependencies.identitiesOnly: Catalogue identities only. Nested rules are not part of this catalogue; select the corresponding policy-entry family for its separate observation.
SdnDependencies.displayLimit: Showing the first {{limit}} of {{total}} returned entries.
SdnDependencies.referenceBoundary: Not visible can mean absent, hidden by permissions, or changed between reads. A visible target is not proof of a valid configuration. Running references to IPAM/DNS use their configured-only catalogue. Pending-field overlays are not resolved into a dependency graph.
SdnDependencies.noReferences: No supported references were observed for this selection; dependencies may remain unobserved.

reasons.view_not_exposed: This native collection does not expose this configuration view.
reasons.inspection_deadline: The inspection deadline was reached before this read completed.
reasons.response_limit: This collection exceeded the aggregate response budget.
reasons.parent_inventory_unavailable: At least one VNet inventory view was unavailable; subnet enumeration is incomplete.

referenceStatus.not_visible: Target not visible; existence is unverified

unobservedNames.fabric_runtime_and_withheld_fields: fabric runtime and withheld configuration fields

SdnDependencies.unobservedFallback: Additional dependencies remain unverified; coverage details are unavailable.
SdnDependencies.policyBoundary: Parsed policy configuration only; FRR evaluation and live enforcement are unverified. Native pending rows can carry identities in their overlay, and deletion markers are preserved. Unknown fields and unsupported peer text are withheld. Catalogue and entry reads may have different native permission filters. Pending overlays are not merged into an executable policy.
SdnDependencies.nestedDisplayLimit: {{field}}: showing the first {{limit}} of {{total}} returned items.
SdnDependencies.fabricBoundary: Fabric configuration only. Node keys include both fabric and node; a node can belong to multiple fabrics. Interface and peer matches stay in the same observed configuration view and fabric. They do not prove host interface existence, active sessions, a WireGuard handshake, routing validity or connectivity. Keys, endpoints, addresses and unsupported fields are withheld; pending overlays are not resolved into a graph.
SdnDependencies.unsupportedFabricProtocol: This fabric protocol is not supported by this reader. Identities remain visible; protocol-specific details are withheld.

SdnAttachments.title: Guest NIC and host-interface observations
SdnAttachments.boundary: Read-only, partial observations. Matching names do not verify connectivity or establish a complete impact graph. SDN apply remains blocked.
SdnAttachments.selection: Selected {{selected}} of {{total}} visible entries (limit {{limit}}); {{omitted}} omitted by the selection limit.
SdnAttachments.coverage: Hidden or unselected guests and nodes, snapshots, passthrough devices, host pending diffs, management paths, nested SDN policies, provider versions and live connectivity remain unverified.
SdnAttachments.guestBoundary: Current configuration is not a live guest-network probe. The pending-merged view includes pending edits and removals. The two views are read independently and may race with migration or native changes.
SdnAttachments.noNics: No NIC entries are visible in this configuration view. This does not rule out passthrough devices or hidden dependencies.

targets.host_interface: Interface name on the guest node

match.not_visible: Name not visible; may be absent, hidden or changed
match.not_observed: Target not observed or not selected

SdnAttachments.hostBoundary: Host reports combine configuration and runtime flags and may include staged settings. Active or existing interfaces do not prove reachability. Host pending diffs and result metadata are not inspected.

DashboardObservation.visibleScope: Counts include only resources visible to the controller credential. Collection time does not establish the age of native samples; this is not an atomic snapshot.
DashboardObservation.storageScope: Disk capacity describes node filesystems, not datastore capacity or safe workload placement.
DashboardObservation.registrationScope: Fleet totals are by registered controller. Physical clusters are not deduplicated; multiple registrations can count the same infrastructure more than once. Node coverage excludes failed controllers whose node counts are unknown.
DashboardObservation.refreshRequired: Current values are hidden until a fresh, valid observation is available.
DashboardObservation.separateTasks: Task counts have a separate collection lifecycle and are not qualified by the dashboard observation above.
DashboardObservation.haBoundary: Visible entries do not establish HA health or failover readiness.
